opening.argument: The presentation ties a ChatGPT-based Ethereum arbitrage bot to “easy daily passive income” and directs viewers to fund a deployed smart contract with Ethereum. It specifies a minimum deposit of 0.2 ETH to the contract or bot address, then instructs users to start the bot, while the deployed-contract panel shows start and withdraw controls. The speaker reports 2.31 ETH as “over 15% profit already” and says it took a day to recover over 25% of the deposit. Although profits are said to fluctuate, these unusually high return claims are paired with direct instructions to deposit Ethereum and operate the bot, making the solicitation materially risky despite that qualification.

citations.quote: Today, I'll be walking you through the process of deploying an Ethereum arbitrage bot using ChatGPT which is your ticket to easy daily passive income.
Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address
So I have about 2.31 Ethereum which is over 15% profit already.
So it basically took me a day to make over 25% of my deposit back!
